name: Neon Asakusa
source:
Neon Asakusa is an Academy student from Konohagakure. Her parents are executive members of the Kaminarimon Company. Neon is soft-spoken and timid. Insecure by nature, she easily lets herself get bossed around by others. She is a very caring person, worrying about the feelings of others. Neon is fair-skinned of average height with purple eyes and brown hair. Her hair is chin-length and bob-cut styled with the right side tucked behind her ear. Neon is quite intelligent, frequently using and testing several Kaminarimon Company prototypes for her parents, who are executive members.
